Brazilian passport holders do not get visa-free entry to Vietnam, so for your 3-week (21-day) trip you'll need an e-Visa.

**Primary pathway: e-Visa**
- Apply online at https://evisa.gov.vn/
- Allows a stay of up to 90 days, so your 21-day trip comfortably fits within that limit
- Cost: USD 25 for single-entry or USD 50 for multiple-entry
- Processing time: 2-3 business days (expedited options available for an extra fee)
- Valid for entry by air, land, or sea, and usable at any of the approved e-Visa ports (this dataset tracks an 83-port list) — no need to name a single entry port in advance

**Other requirements**
- Your passport must be valid for at least 180 days from your date of entry to Vietnam

This is based on policy data as of 2026-08-17 — since immigration rules can change, I'd recommend double-checking current requirements at evisa.gov.vn before you apply or travel.
